verdict: Avoid new pharma/API exposure in Mandideep for now; lend only to profitable, low-concentration formulation-linked units with tight structure, and decline API-only or single-customer borrowers.
title: Mandideep Pharmaceuticals & APIs: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
Lupin runs a Mandideep site hiring across QC, microbiology, production, QA and warehouse roles [3], so the cluster has an anchor employer and a supplier ecosystem around it. **Value sits in regulatory approvals and customer qualification, not in capacity** — a line without a filed dossier is scrap. ## What has changed now
**The data pack reads AVOID at 26, and the local signal is the reason: Madhya Pradesh GST collections are -0.1% Apr-to-date against India +6.1%, 6.2 pp slower [D].** India-wide output is -2.1% Apr-to-date [D], while bank credit is +21.6% YoY [D] — money is chasing a shrinking base, so weak units are being kept alive on debt. **So when a proposal lands, check whether the last two years of growth came from volumes or from a lender refinancing receivables; if the latter, ask for the customer-wise sales register and decline.** Peers are not the problem: Aarti Pharmalabs posted record quarterly revenue of Rs. 613 crore, up 47% YoY, with EBITDA margin at 22.2% [4][6], and RPG Life Sciences grew Q2 FY27 revenue 16.5% to Rs. 211.6 crore [7] while targeting 25% API growth [5]. **The gap between good and bad API units is widening, and Mandideep's small units sit on the wrong side of it.**

## Where the growth is
**Pursue formulation-linked suppliers to the Mandideep anchor plants and CDMO/contract-research units with named, repeat customers.** The API industry grew at 8.4% CAGR between CY2017 and CY2022E and is expected at ~7% [11], and China still supplies 65-70% of India's API imports [11] — import substitution is the real order book. **Avoid API-only units with one customer or one product; rating reports show customer concentration is the standard killer [8].**

## How to grow safely
**Structure as CC/OD against receivables with a stock statement, not a term loan for capacity.** Working capital intensity in this sector has run 47-52% [10], so size the limit to the cycle, not the request. **Take monthly: stock-and-receivable statement, GST returns, top-five customer ledger, and power bills.** If receivable days stretch beyond the sanctioned cycle, ask for the customer confirmation before the next enhancement. ## Early-warning signs
**Watch GST turnover falling while bank turnover rises — that is diversion.** Also watch inventory days climbing without a new approval, and any request to fund a customer's payment terms. Rating reports flag weak contract-research demand from US clients as a real revenue hit [8]; if a borrower's export orders thin, ask for the order book before renewal.

## Local coverage is thin
**The local sources are job listings and topic pages, not financial news [1][2][3]; treat Mandideep-specific data as absent and lean on first principles plus peer results.**
